verdict.rationale: The evidence documents batch APIs, webhooks, an MCP server, a CLI, and integrations with n8n, Make and Zapier. None of it shows a HeyGen-native way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Recurrence would depend on external orchestrators (a user-side workaround) or on building it from API primitives (developer building blocks), and neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
